# KIEZJOB — Berlin's Flexible Work & Minijob Portal

> KIEZJOB is Berlin's dedicated job board for flexible employment — Minijobs (538€/603€), part-time work (Teilzeit), student jobs (Werkstudent), temporary gigs, and individual shifts — across all 12 Berlin districts in German and English.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://kiezjob.de/): Browse all flexible work opportunities in Berlin with interactive OpenStreetMap view
- [Post a Job](https://kiezjob.de/post-a-job): Employers post job listings for €29 single or €499/year unlimited
- [Direct from Employers](https://kiezjob.de/direct-employers): All jobs posted directly by verified Berlin employers
- [Latest Verified Jobs](https://kiezjob.de/latest-jobs): Freshly sourced and verified job opportunities

## Job Categories (30 Berlin Niches)

- [Gastronomy & Cafés](https://kiezjob.de/categories/gastronomy): Restaurants, cafés, bakeries and catering teams
- [Hotels & Accommodation](https://kiezjob.de/categories/hotels): Hotels, hostels, serviced apartments and guest houses
- [Events & Venues](https://kiezjob.de/categories/events): Event crews, venues, trade fairs and temporary productions
- [Retail & Shops](https://kiezjob.de/categories/retail): Independent shops, chains, fashion and specialty retail
- [Supermarkets & Food Retail](https://kiezjob.de/categories/food-retail): Supermarkets, organic stores, kiosks and food counters
- [Warehousing & Fulfilment](https://kiezjob.de/categories/warehousing): Order picking, packing, stock and distribution centre roles
- [Logistics & Delivery](https://kiezjob.de/categories/logistics): Bicycle couriers, van drivers and last-mile delivery
- [Cleaning & Facilities](https://kiezjob.de/categories/cleaning): Office, commercial and residential cleaning teams
- [Office & Administration](https://kiezjob.de/categories/office-admin): Reception, data entry, filing and general office support
- [Customer Support](https://kiezjob.de/categories/customer-support): Call centres, live chat and email support desks
- [Sales & Promotion](https://kiezjob.de/categories/sales-promotion): In-store promotion, brand ambassadors, street marketing
- [Tourism & Visitor Services](https://kiezjob.de/categories/tourism): Tour guides, museum staff, visitor information and travel agencies
- [Culture, Museums & Theatres](https://kiezjob.de/categories/culture): Galleries, theatres, cinemas and cultural institutions
- [Nightlife & Clubs](https://kiezjob.de/categories/nightlife): Bars, clubs, door staff and late-night hospitality
- [Sports, Fitness & Recreation](https://kiezjob.de/categories/sports-fitness): Gyms, pools, coaching and leisure centres
- [Childcare & Education](https://kiezjob.de/categories/childcare-education): After-school care, holiday programmes and tutoring
- [Healthcare Support](https://kiezjob.de/categories/healthcare-support): Clinics, pharmacies, care assistants and patient transport
- [Elder Care & Social Services](https://kiezjob.de/categories/elder-care): Home care, nursing support and social work assistants
- [Security & Crowd Services](https://kiezjob.de/categories/security): Door supervision, event security and mobile patrols
- [Construction & Trades](https://kiezjob.de/categories/construction-trades): Helpers for electricians, painters, plumbers and site crews
- [Manufacturing & Production](https://kiezjob.de/categories/manufacturing): Assembly, machine operation and quality control
- [Moving & Transport Help](https://kiezjob.de/categories/moving-transport): Furniture movers, van assistants and transport helpers
- [Universities & Research](https://kiezjob.de/categories/universities-research): Student assistant (HiWi) and lab helper positions
- [NGOs & Associations](https://kiezjob.de/categories/ngo-associations): Charities, community projects and volunteer coordination
- [Media & Creative](https://kiezjob.de/categories/media-creative): Photography, video, design and content creation gigs
- [Beauty & Wellness](https://kiezjob.de/categories/beauty-wellness): Salons, spas, massage and cosmetics
- [Pet Care](https://kiezjob.de/categories/pet-care): Dog walking, pet sitting and veterinary assistance
- [Gardening & Outdoor](https://kiezjob.de/categories/gardening-outdoor): Parks, landscaping and urban gardening projects
- [Seasonal & Markets](https://kiezjob.de/categories/seasonal-markets): Christmas markets, summer festivals and pop-up stands
- [Local Services](https://kiezjob.de/categories/local-services): Handyman, errands, personal assistance and odd jobs

## Berlin District Coverage

All 12 Berlin districts (Bezirke): Mitte, Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg, Pankow (Prenzlauer Berg), Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf, Spandau, Steglitz-Zehlendorf, Tempelhof-Schöneberg, Neukölln, Treptow-Köpenick, Marzahn-Hellersdorf, Lichtenberg, Reinickendorf.

## Key Features

- Interactive OpenStreetMap with wage pin badges for every job
- Direct Google Maps navigation from job listings
- Automatic verbatim text formatting for job descriptions
- Transparent hourly/shift/monthly wage display
- Direct employer email or website application (1-click)
- Free for job seekers, always

## Pricing for Employers

- Single Job Listing: €29 (30 days active)
- Annual Unlimited & Top Listing: €499/year
